thread:
zoe-marketing: Quick alignment: launch is Wed; need a tight "sticky" asset pack for the campaign + webinar — hero slide, one-page benchmark primer, 6 technical microcards, 12 social variants. Figma components + PNG/SVG exports, small GIF/MP4 hero. Locales: en/fr/es. Can design take this on?

leo-design: Yep. Can do. Need exact deliverables, copy limits, and any motion constraints.

zoe-marketing: Deliverables priority:
1) Hero slide (landing + webinar banner)
2) Benchmark primer (one slide, sparkline + bullets)
3) Microcards x6 (cache, batching, kv-cache, quant, routing, fallback)
4) Social variants x12 (mix of 1200x628 & 1080x1080).
Brand: primary palette only, minimal accents. Deadline: Tue EOD (4 days).

mina-creative: Style brief: flat geometric icons, thin strokes, subtle gradient band on hero, 2-frame hero GIF (fade + tiny token sparkle). I'll prototype frames.

leo-design: Export spec proposal:
- Hero: 1600x900 PNG @1x and @2x, GIF 800x450 loop, Figma slide with speaker placeholder
- Primer: 1200x628 PNG + editable PDF slide, sparkline layer editable
- Microcards: 1080x1080 and 1200x628 PNGs, SVG icon set, max 10w headline / 18w body
- Social: PNGs + one 640x360 MP4 teaser for hero variants
File naming: stickypack_<asset>_<locale>_v1.<ext>
Agree?

ash-solutions: Technical note: microcards must avoid hard numbers or guarantees. Use language like "typical latency" or "reduces per-token cost". I'll loop in eng-ml for quick phrase review.

jaime-product: Copy rules: keep bullets benefit-forward, avoid absolutes. I'll deliver final copy by tomorrow morning. Add footnote: "Results vary by workload and model."

brandbot: Brand rules: hexes #0A2540, #0B6FFF, #14D1A1. Use Redwood Sans only. Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for body. Use spacing tokens s-8 / s-16. No outside fonts.

leo-design: OK. Owners: Leo - design lead; Mina - motion; Ash - engineering reviewer; Jaime - copy; Zoe - campaign owner. I'll start component library in Figma and drop hero + 2 microcards by EOD tomorrow.

mina-creative: I'll add two motion frames and a sample GIF tonight.

ash-solutions: I'll prepare an eng-ml review checklist and ping them once mockups are live.

zoe-marketing: Great — tag me in Figma when first pass lands. Also we need 3 CTA variants: Register, Learn more, View benchmark. Keep CTAs short.

leo-design: Noted. Tracking in the creative board under "sticky asset sprint". Will label frames for localization.

zoe-marketing: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag immediately. :rocket:
